fields.why: The 3 PAHO target groups (young children, persons with comorbidities, older adults) are an age x clinical composite; under rule F7 only SPD groups within one level of the clinical variable count, which gives at most 2 age groups, so the Pearson chi-square across target groups is not an SPD groupwise result. A's reading (3 mutually exclusive age bands) is close but rule F7 does not say how to count a partially crossed composite.

brief_issues: Rule F7 (SPD x clinical variable) does not say how to count program target groups that mix age bands with a clinical group (e.g. young children / persons with comorbidities / older adults). Suggested rule: such composite target groups are non-SPD groups (comparison only) unless 3+ age groups are compared within one clinical level.
